verdict.rationale: Check documents an API flow to create, preview and approve a payroll, and an official MCP server lets an agent run payroll and pull payroll details and diagnostics. That covers the agent-driven preview-then-approve core. Nothing documents anomaly detection or flagging on a payroll preview, so surfacing anomalies would fall to the agent's own reasoning over the returned data. missing for 10: documented anomaly or variance detection on payroll previews, an explicit agent review-before-approval workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent run a payroll preview via the API and surface anomalies for review before I approve the run
